text:
jordan: FYI deploybot blocked EU canary for connector-proxy:2025.08.12-rc due to SBOM license + runtime vuln.
deploybot: [automated] Canary blocked: policy LCN-4 (runtime license) + vuln-scan failure on redwood/connector-proxy:2025.08.12-rc
deploybot: Detected package: legacy-xml v0.9.5 (runtime) - license: AGPL-3.0 - CVE-2025-4242 CVSS 8.6 - path: connector-proxy -> xml-utils -> legacy-xml
viktor: AGPL in runtime is a blocker for redistributables. Maria, did this come from the base image?
maria: checked registry SBOM: legacy-xml is brought in by xml-utils in app dependency layer. SBOM shows signature present but provenance indicates upstream commit without CLA note.
sbom-bot: SBOM provenance: SIGNATURE_PRESENT, SOURCE_INFO: missing contributor-cla.md
security: CVE seems to allow XXE leading to possible RCE in some parsers. Our usage only feeds controlled input, but cannot assume safe.
jordan: options: 1) rollback EU canary now; 2) swap xml-utils to patched version that drops legacy-xml; 3) rebuild image with vendorized minimal XML parser.
release-coordinator: change window for EU ends in 50m. Swap + rebuild ~40-70m. Rollback ~12m.
oncall-eu: impact if we rollback? minimal, canary telemetry pause for EU only.
legal: AGPL in runtime prohibits us from shipping binary to customers without offering source under AGPL; this is a legal block. We need removal or replacement before any customer-visible rollout.
viktor: can we do a regional carve-out: keep us-east canary; rollback EU/APAC?
jordan: yes. Deploybot supports regional rollbacks: `/deploy rollback --env=eu --service=connector-proxy --to-tag=2025.07.30-stable`
deploybot: Rollback initiated for EU by jordan
deploybot: Rollback complete: connector-proxy@2025.07.30-stable in EU
jordan: APAC next after EU confirmed.
maria: opening PR hotfix/xml-replace to swap to permissive-parser v1.2. small surface change. I'll request expedited review.
release-coordinator: please attach SBOM + cosign sig once new image is built. Policy SBN-2 requires signed SBOM + license check green before promote.
sbom-bot: awaiting new SBOM upload for tag 2025.08.12-fixed
maria: CI: build started. `BUILD OK` `cosign sign`
sbom-bot: SBOM check: PASS (license OK), provenance: SIGNATURE_PRESENT, vuln-scan: PASS
security: will do smoke and focused fuzz on xml endpoints post-promote.
legal: once license cleared, legal will sign off on customer rollout. Keep release notes neutral.
jordan: plan: regional rollback completed, PR in flight, new image signed and scanned. If green within change window, we'll re-promote EU; otherwise schedule next change window.
release-coordinator: created incident INC-2025-0812-9 assigned to supply-chain + security.
viktor: quick reactions? :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
 (end)
